name: Albert Payne
original_name: アルベルト · パイン
source:
The main character. Second-year student at Carlson Academy.
He is the president of the Student Council, has excellent grades and is highly trusted by teachers and students. However, his true identity is the orphan of the Neo-Terran faction who was defeated in the Hermes conflict.
On the surface, he is sociable, cheerful, friendly and loved by everyone.

However, on the inside, he is a ruthless conspirator who use any means to reach his goal. He has strong action and leadership, and has charismatic control within the school.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=922863&gc=gcl]Getchu[/url]]
